questions.text:
A shaving set company sells 4 different types of razors- Elegance, Smooth, Soft and Executive.
Elegance sells at Rs. 48, Smooth at Rs. 63, Soft at Rs. 78 and Executive at Rs. 173 per piece. The table below shows the numbers of each razor sold in each quarter of a year.

[latex]\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|} \hline \textbf{Quarter/Product} & \textbf{Elegance} &\textbf{Smooth} &\textbf{Soft} & \textbf{Executive}\\\hline \text{Q1} & \text{27300} &\text{20009} &\text{17602} &\text{9999}\\\hline \text{Q2} & \text{25222} &\text{19392} & \text{18445}& \text{8942}\\\hline \text{Q3} & \text{28976} &\text{22429} & \text{19544} & \text{10234}\\\hline \text{Q4} &\text{21012} & \text{18229} & \text{16595} & \text{10109}\\\hline \end{array}[/latex]

Which product contributes the greatest fraction to the revenue of the company in that year?
questions.solution:
Yearly revenue = price [latex]\times[/latex] total units:
- Elegance: 48 [latex]\times[/latex] 102510 [latex]\approx[/latex] 49.2 lakh
- Smooth: 63 [latex]\times[/latex] 80059 [latex]\approx[/latex] 50.4 lakh
- Soft: 78 [latex]\times[/latex] 72186 [latex]\approx[/latex] 56.3 lakh
- Executive: 173 [latex]\times[/latex] 39284 [latex]\approx[/latex] 68.0 lakh

Answer: Executive

questions.text:
Indian currency notes show the denomination indicated in at least seventeen languages. If this is not an indication of the nation's diversity, nothing else is.

Which of the following can be logically inferred from the above sentences?
questions.solution:
The sentence says the many languages on the notes are a clear sign of diversity, so linguistic plurality is strong evidence of India's diversity. It does not say exactly 17 languages, or that language is the only indicator.

Answer: Linguistic pluralism is strong evidence of India's diversity.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements relating to the level of poker play of four players P, Q, R and S.

I. P always beats Q
II. R always beats S
III. S loses to P only sometimes.
IV. R always loses to Q

Which of the following can be logically inferred from the above statements?

(i). P is likely to beat all the three other players
(ii). S is the absolute worst player in the set
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- (i): P beats Q always and S only sometimes; nothing is said about P vs R [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] cannot conclude P beats all three.
- (ii): S loses to R, but S sometimes beats P, so S is not clearly the worst; there is also no information on S vs Q.

Answer: neither (i) nor (ii)

questions.text: If [latex]f(x) = 2x^{7}+3x-5[/latex], which of the following is a factor of [latex]f(x)[/latex]?
questions.solution:
Factor theorem: [latex]f(1)=2+3-5=0[/latex], so [latex](x-1)[/latex] is a factor.
(f([latex]-[/latex]1) = [latex]-[/latex]2 [latex]-[/latex] 3 [latex]-[/latex] 5 [latex]\ne[/latex] 0, so x + 1 is not.)

Answer: x-1

questions.text: In a process, the number of cycles to failure decreases exponentially with an increase in load. At a load of 80 units, it takes 100 cycles for failure. When the load is halved, it takes 10000 cycles for failure.The load for which the failure will happen in 5000 cycles is _________
questions.solution:
Let cycles [latex]N=Ae^{-kL}[/latex]. Halving the load from 80 to 40 multiplies N by 100, so [latex]e^{40k}=100[/latex].

From L = 40 (10000 cycles) to 5000 cycles: [latex]e^{k(L-40)}=2\Rightarrow L-40=\frac{40\ln2}{\ln100}=40\times\frac{0.301}{2}=6.02[/latex]

L = 46.02

Answer: 46.02
